Instead of saying “don’t let me switch up”, Chief Keef says “don’t let me switch out”, referring to an illegal modification of a Glock firearm that allows it to fire in full auto with the assistance of a “switch”.

A Glock switch is a modification that is attached to the back of a Glock pistol, stopping the trigger mechanism from hitting the override to the trigger bar, not allowing the trigger bar to reset into it’s semi automatic state. As a result, this makes the pistol fire multiple bullets at a time in vein of a machine pistol.

(I do not have experience with switches. I am not a criminal. Please do not lock me up.)
